prompt: Turn this rough painted sketch into a photorealistic industrial-design studio product render of one compact handheld camera. Keep the exact same 3/4 front view, composition, form and proportions as the sketch: rounded hand grip on the left, lens on the front right, dark rectangular viewfinder block on top rear left, dark cylindrical dial block on top right. Concept: entropy, light losing its energy as it falls into a black hole. Core body: deep matte black, velvety, light-absorbing paint. Over it run two or three plump inflated tubes with round cross-sections and smooth satin paint; they are rays of light losing energy. The CMF tells the story through one continuous, smooth colour and value gradient along the length of every tube: at the hand grip the tubes are bright warm white (soft ivory, like warm light), as they rise over the top and twist and cross each other between the viewfinder and the dial they cool and darken through pale grey to mid grey, and as they curve down onto the front and wrap a thick ring around the lens they become charcoal and finally near-black, melting seamlessly into the black core around the lens so the end of the tube disappears into the darkness. The gradient is painted (airbrushed, no hard bands, no stripes), smooth and continuous from grip to lens. Lens: a real camera lens about 35 mm in diameter at the centre of the dark ring, black anodized barrel with fine knurling, dark coated front glass with concentric inner element reflections and a faint purple-green coating sheen. All solid painted material: no LED, no glow, no emitted light. Clearly visible details: round black shutter button on top of the grip; small USB-C port in a black inset on the outer left side face of the grip; knurled black cap on the dial block. Clean continuous surfaces, generous fillets, crisp part lines, reads as a 3D-printed and painted design model. One single camera fully in frame, centred, seamless clean white studio background, large soft key light from upper left, soft contact shadow, high-end product photography, sharp focus. No text, no logos, no watermark, no hands, no extra objects.
